title: pit_stats per-pass artifact (v1)
description: Versioned cross-stage contract for s3://{research-bucket}/parity/{run_date}/pit_stats_{pass}.json — the per-pass skilled-risk-basket stats each pit_parity predictor pass (lookahead | walkforward) publishes when the pass runs as its own Step Functions stage (alpha-engine-config#6030, splitting the bundled Parity SF state per sf-pipeline-policy §2.1). Written by crucible-backtester analysis/pit_stats_artifact.py::publish_pass_artifact (invoked via `backtest.py --pit-parity-pass-publish <pass>` on the pass's own spot instance). Consumed by analysis/pit_stats_artifact.py::run_compare_and_publish (the PitParityCompare SF stage), which reads BOTH pass artifacts, computes delta_pit_minus_current (ΔSortino/ΔPSR/ΔCVaR/Δmax-DD/PBO) and writes backtest/{run_date}/pit_parity.json. The `stats` block lifts the EXACT field subset the in-process implementation (analysis/pit_parity.py::run_pit_parity + build_contamination_report) consumed from the pickled per-pass stats dicts — no invented fields; the full in-memory stats dict is deliberately NOT serialized. Pickle is not an acceptable cross-boundary format (M0 contract rule): all values are JSON with numpy/pandas coerced explicitly — non-finite floats become null. Additive-only evolution: new optional fields may be added under the same major version; renames/removals/type changes require a major `schema` bump coordinated with the compare consumer AND the nousergon-data SF-level consumer contract (nousergon-data contracts/pit_stats_pass.consumer.json).

run_date.description: The SF-stamped weekly run_date (NYSE trading day) — the same date key every backtest/{date}/ artifact of the run shares.

pass.description: Which pit_parity pass produced this artifact. 'lookahead' = the legacy single-pass (look-ahead-contaminated) comparator; 'walkforward' = the point-in-time PIT pass.

status.description: 'ok' iff the pass completed and `stats` is trustworthy. Any other value ('failed', 'error', 'insufficient_data', ...) means the compare stage must treat this pass as unavailable and emit its parity verdict as UNKNOWN — never as a pass (sf-pipeline-policy §2.3a).

error_class.description: Exception class name when status != 'ok' via the failure path.

error_msg.description: Truncated exception message when status != 'ok' via the failure path.

wall_clock_seconds.description: Measured wall-clock of the isolated pass subprocess (alpha-engine-config-I6026 deliverable 2 — the series per-stage timeout calibration is seeded from).

stats.description: The exact per-pass stats subset the in-process compare consumed. Keys mirror the in-memory dict verbatim, including the private _cscv_* names, so the compare-side reconstruction is an identity mapping.

daily_log_returns.description: Per-date portfolio log returns (plan invariant 5). Non-finite entries are serialized as null; the consumer coerces null -> NaN and filters via np.isfinite, matching the in-process behavior.

predictor_metadata.description: The pass's predictor metadata dict. The compare consumes predictor_metadata.walk_forward (fold count, cold-start exclusions) from the walkforward pass only.

_cscv_block_matrix.description: (n_blocks, n_combos) Sortino CSCV block matrix — present only on a walkforward pass that ran the opt-in pit_parity_sweep (config#816 decision B). null => pbo reported null by the compare, never fabricated.

_cscv_n_trials.description: Number of swept combos, for the DSR multiple-testing deflation.
